query: CREATE TABLE service_account(id UUID NOT NULL, workspace_id UUID NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, deleted TIMESTAMPTZ, actor_type WORKSPACE_ACTOR_TYPE NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS ('service_account') STORED, actor_client_type ACTOR_CLIENT_TYPE NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS ('service_account') STORED);
